Uniswap Labs is a core contributor to the Uniswap Protocol, the world’s largest DEX, with over $4 trillion in volume across 17 chains. It builds products that help millions access the protocol, including the Uniswap Web App, Wallet, and Trading API. Uniswap Labs is also the primary technical provider for Unichain, a DeFi-native Ethereum Layer 2 built to be the home for liquidity across chains.

When you join Uniswap, you become part of a team that's reshaping the way value flows on the internet.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture and strategy of our systems. This is a unique opportunity to lead technical initiatives, drive innovation, and ensure Uniswap remains at the forefront of crypto.

What You'll Do

  • Drive end to end execution of technical projects, from ideation and design to deployment.

  • Design and build resilient, large-scale systems from the ground up with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance.

  • Write high quality and well tested code, and review code from other team members.

  • Provide thought leadership and guide peers in navigating complex architectural and coding decisions.

  • Champion best practices and technical excellence across the engineering organization.

  • Spearhead strategic technical initiatives that impact multiple engineering pods and deliver organization-wide improvements.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining large-scale, production-level systems.

  • Experience as a Technical Lead or in a similar leadership capacity.

  • Exceptional coding skills, with expertise in cloud architecture, distributed systems, and algorithms.

  • Proven ability to independently lead projects, including requirement gathering, system design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • A track record of mentoring and guiding engineers to achieve their potential.

  • A 0→1 mindset with the ability to build systems and processes from scratch.

  • Deep interest in modern development practices and a passion for shaping the future of crypto technology.

Nice to Have

  • Prior work with time-series based monitoring and observability systems.

  • Knowledge of TypeScript, Go, GraphQL, and AWS

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • A love for unicorns

Minimum full-time salary of $207,000-$259,000. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law. Full Time employees at Uniswap Labs are also eligible for other compensation elements, including tokens, and benefits, dependent on the position type.

Uniswap Labs' Full-Time employee benefits include company-paid medical, dental, & vision for you and your dependents, wellness offerings including a partnership with Equinox Fitness Clubs, 401(k) with 4% employer contribution, annual $1,500 education stipend, unlimited and encouraged time off, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, home office setup stipend for remote employees and daily lunches at NY headquarters (all benefits are subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility).

"},{"id":"c9fe612e-7c29-47a4-b2a3-2a9d1185f5ef","title":"Senior Frontend Infrastructure Engineer","department":"Engineering","team":"Developer/Apps Infra","employmentType":"FullTime","location":"New York","secondaryLocations":[],"publishedAt":"2026-03-18T18:49:18.350+00:00","isListed":true,"isRemote":true,"workplaceType":"Hybrid","address":{"postalAddress":{"addressRegion":"New York","addressCountry":"United States","addressLocality":"New York"}},"jobUrl":"https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/uniswap/c9fe612e-7c29-47a4-b2a3-2a9d1185f5ef","applyUrl":"https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/uniswap/c9fe612e-7c29-47a4-b2a3-2a9d1185f5ef/application","descriptionHtml":"

Uniswap Labs builds products that help millions of people access DeFi simply and securely — from the Uniswap Web App and Wallet to crypto infrastructure like the Uniswap Trading API, and Unichain. Uniswap Labs also contributes to the development of the Uniswap Protocol, which has processed over $2.9 trillion in volume across thousands of tokens on Ethereum and 12+ other chains.

When you join Uniswap, you become part of a team that's reshaping the way value flows on the internet.

The Apps Infra team is the horizontal foundation that every product team at Uniswap builds on. We own the data layer, design systems, release and QA automation, UI libraries, and shared frontend services. We're product-centric at our core — the infra we build is always in service of the user experience, and we regularly contribute to product and design engineering work alongside our tooling and platform responsibilities. We also contribute heavily to AI-powered internal tools and automations that help the engineering org ship faster. We're looking for a senior engineer who goes deep: someone who can drive a large-scale migration one week, build an AI-powered CLI tool the next, and ship a polished UI component the week after that. You'll have strong opinions on tooling, care about developer experience, and treat product quality as the backbone of everything you build.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve Uniswap's shared frontend infrastructure — design systems, UI component libraries, data-fetching layers (React Query), and notification systems — across web and mobile

  • Contribute to product and design engineering work, keeping the team closely connected to what users experience

  • Build and contribute to AI-powered internal tools and automations — changelog builders, cherry-pick automations, CLI tools, and workflows that use LLMs like Claude to accelerate development

  • Lead large-scale migrations (e.g., Tamagui → Tailwind) with strong opinions on tooling choices and a plan that other teams can follow

  • Build and improve release automation, CI/CD pipelines, and QA tooling to increase reliability and developer velocity

  • Drive performance improvements across the all of our apps

  • Maintain backend-for-frontend services that support multiple product teams

  • Produce high-quality, well-tested code and thoughtful architecture docs; set the bar on PR reviews

  • Mentor engineers across teams through code review, documentation, and establishing best practices where none exist

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience

  • Deep experience with both React and React Native; comfort working across web and mobile from a single codebase

  • Strong track record building developer tooling, design systems, or shared infrastructure — with a product sensibility that keeps you connected to what users actually touch

  • Opinions on frontend architecture, styling systems, data-fetching patterns, and build tooling — and the ability to back them up

  • Experience owning and delivering large, ambiguous projects end-to-end with minimal direction

  • Comfort with automation: CI/CD, release engineering, testing frameworks

  • Eager to push the boundaries of AI-assisted development — not just using the tools, but exploring what's newly possible

  • A desire to keep up with modern best practices in web and mobile development

Nice to Have

  • Active open source contributions — especially to projects like wagmi, viem, Next.js, React Router, TanStack, or similar frontend/tooling ecosystems

  • Experience building AI-powered developer tools, CLI tools, or internal automations with LLMs

  • Experience with Swift/Kotlin or native mobile development

  • Familiarity with crypto features and concepts — candidates with no crypto experience are still welcome (encouraged!) to apply

  • Experience at companies that value this kind of infra/platform/DX role (e.g., Shopify, Vercel, Replit, Phantom, Coinbase)

  • Degree in computer science

  • Love for unicorns :)

Minimum full-time salary of $180,000-$226,000. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law. Full Time employees at Uniswap Labs are also eligible for other compensation elements, including tokens, and benefits, dependent on the position type.

Uniswap Labs' Full-Time employee benefits include company-paid medical, dental, & vision for you and your dependents, wellness offerings including a partnership with Equinox Fitness Clubs, 401(k) with 4% employer contribution, annual $1,500 education stipend, unlimited and encouraged time off, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, home office setup stipend for remote employees and daily lunches at NY headquarters (all benefits are subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility).

Ecosystem Growth Manager

Uniswap Labs is a core contributor to the Uniswap Protocol, the world's largest DEX, with over $4 trillion in volume across 17 chains. It builds products that help millions access the protocol, including the Uniswap Web App, Wallet, and Trading API.

We’re looking for someone to develop new partnerships, grow strategic relationships, and turn market opportunities into successful initiatives. You’ll own work from early evaluation and negotiation through launch and expansion, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Legal.

We are headquartered in SoHo in New York City. This role will be based in our office with an expectation of regular in-person collaboration.

What you’ll do

  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities, using data, market research, and partner insights to build business cases and guide investment.

  • Structure and negotiate complex deals, including first-of-their-kind partnerships that expand Uniswap’s distribution and unlock new use cases.

  • Own relationships with Uniswap’s largest and most strategic partners, aligning on shared goals and driving growth from launch through expansion.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to translate partner needs and market opportunities into product requirements and roadmap priorities.

  • Drive cross-functional execution across integrations and launches, resolve blockers, and measure results through adoption and protocol volume.

Who you are

You have experience in business development, strategic partnerships, corporate strategy, product management, or related growth roles in crypto, fintech, payments or similar

  • You bring strong commercial acumen and analytical skills, with experience evaluating opportunities, negotiating agreements, and growing complex partner relationships

  • You’re comfortable with technical products and can work with product and engineering teams to evaluate integrations, define requirements, and make tradeoffs.

  • You communicate clearly, build trust with partners and colleagues, and take ownership of ambiguous initiatives for which there is no detailed playbook.

  • You have a strong interest in DeFi and onchain markets. Direct experience with trading, liquidity, or financial infrastructure is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience at a major fintech, exchange, or HFT/market-making firm.

  • Technical experience working on crypto protocols, DeFi, or open source software.

  • Deeply integrated with DeFi ecosystem partners and trading protocols.

  • Love for unicorns :)

Minimum full-time salary of $180,000-$220,000. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law. Full Time employees at Uniswap Labs are also eligible for other compensation elements, including tokens, and benefits, dependent on the position type.

Uniswap Labs' Full-Time employee benefits include company-paid medical, dental, & vision for you and your dependents, wellness offerings including a partnership with Equinox Fitness Clubs, 401(k) with 4% employer contribution, annual $1,500 education stipend, unlimited and encouraged time off, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, home office setup stipend for remote employees and daily lunches at NY headquarters (all benefits are subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility).

As the Head of Institutions, you will play a pivotal role in helping scale Uniswap’s institutional business. The role is uniquely positioned to operate across business strategy and development, internal and external stakeholder relationship management, partnership GTM motions, and corporate strategy. As a business leader, you will report directly to Hayden Adams (CEO).

What you'll do:

  • Establish and execute institutional strategy where Uniswap is complementary to financial institutions: identifying novel use cases, bespoke market structures, partnerships, and pathways to greater adoption

  • Develop institutional GTM motions, from segmentation and positioning to pipeline development, commercial models, and partner success, supporting internal and external development

  • Source, negotiate, and lead strategic partnerships with banks, asset managers, funds, and others leveraging both your existing and organizational network

  • Expand adoption and business outcomes owning institutional growth goals and identifying new opportunities for volume, distribution, and mutual success

  • Translate market signals into company strategy with a deep understanding of institutional customer needs, market structure, competitive dynamics, and emerging trends, synthesizing insights into clear recommendations for product roadmap, growth strategy, and partnership priorities

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering representing institutional partner needs, developing business cases for new opportunities, and evaluating requirements to unlock meaningful adoption

  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives as the business DRI for high-priority institutional opportunities, coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy, Marketing, Finance, and other teams to move from idea to closing deals

  • Build executive-level relationships representing Uniswap with senior leaders across traditional finance, fintech, payments, and digital asset departments to develop long-term relationships shaping the future of financial markets

What you'll bring:

  • 7+ years of experience across business development, strategic partnerships, sales, strategy, or related roles in fintech, payments, capital markets, financial infrastructure

  • Demonstrated success in developing and closing complex, high-impact partnerships with large financial institutions or enterprise customers

  • Experience building a new business, market, customer segment, or GTM motion rather than solely operating within an established sales organization

  • Strong knowledge of how banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, fintechs, payments companies, or other financial institutions evaluate and adopt new technologies

  • The ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, with comfort developing a multi-year strategy and personally leading partner meetings and negotiations

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to evaluate opportunities based on strategic value, customer impact, economics, and likelihood of execution

  • Track record of product fluency having uncovered underlying needs of partner requests, and translating external feedback into useful feedback for Product and Engineering teams

  • Executive presence and the ability to build credibility with senior leaders at sophisticated financial institutions

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for simplify complex market, technical, and commercial concepts

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure

Must-have Experience & Skills

  • Experience with crypto, DeFi, tokenization, stablecoins, quant trading, or other emerging tech infrastructure

  • Experience working across both traditional financial institutions and high-growth tech orgs

  • Experience building or leading small, high-performing growth teams

  • A strong network across banks, fintechs, payments companies, asset managers, trading firms, or related financial institutions

  • Experience bringing a technical or emerging product from an early-adopter market into more established enterprise or institutional customers

Minimum full-time salary of $200,000-$300,000. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law. Full Time employees at Uniswap Labs are also eligible for other compensation elements, including tokens, and benefits, dependent on the position type.

Content Marketer

We’re looking for a self-motivated Content Marketer to help tell the story of crypto and DeFi, and Uniswap’s place in it. You’ll create content across social media, blog posts, emails and ads, with a focus on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Reddit. You’ll write everything from explainer threads to launch campaigns to content that helps developers build on Uniswap.

Working with product, design, business development, engineering, and research, you’ll help take ideas from concept to launch: shaping the content calendar, supporting go-to-market plans, and keeping every piece in Uniswap’s distinct voice. You’ll use analytics to learn what resonates with our audiences and feed those insights into what we make next. You know crypto and DeFi inside out, you have a sharp ear for tone, and you’re always trying new platforms and tools, including LLMs, to reach people where they are.

  • Responsibilities

    • Produce compelling and engaging content for various marketing channels including social media, blog posts, emails, and ads

    • Assist in executing our overall social strategy from concepting ideas, to coordinating among teams, to executing, to creatively bringing messages to life to our community

    • Assist with content creation and execution from start to finish for all platforms, in coordination with multiple teams and while maintaining Uniswap's distinct brand tone

    • Support in developing the social media calendar for all platforms, which is integrated with communications and product timelines

    • Assist with executing GTM plans by partnering cross-functionally with internal team members and external stakeholders

    • Run analytics and develop insights that are relevant to our core audiences and integrate findings into engagement planning

    • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices to ensure our marketing efforts remain current and effective

    Requirements

    • 1-3 years of experience running multiple social media platforms for an organization or agency

    • Obsessed with crypto and DeFi as transformative opportunities

    • Proven ability to use social media to maintain or build a brand, with experience in everything from explainer threads, to product marketing, to banger memes

    • Excellent copywriting skills and ability to develop and adapt tone of voice

    • Deep understanding of social media platforms, especially X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Reddit

    Nice to Haves

    • Graphic design experience and familiarity with basic design tools to create image content

    • Experience creating content with new tools & platforms like LLMs

    • Love for unicorns :)

Workplace Experience Coordinator, New York (SoHo)

About Uniswap Labs
The Uniswap Labs team is building products to unlock value through universal exchange. Our products are the Uniswap Interface, the Uniswap Mobile App and the Uniswap Extension, all powered by the Uniswap Protocol. When you join Uniswap, you become part of a team reshaping how value flows on the internet.
About the role
We’re looking for a workplace coordinator to own the day-to-day operations of our headquarters in SoHo, New York. You’ll be the heart of the office. You’ll make sure every teammate, new hire and guest who walks through our doors has a great experience, and you’ll build a workspace people want to come to every day.
This role calls for strong planning, communication and organization. It also calls for someone who can handle many internal and external requests at once and stay composed, courteous and efficient while doing it. It’s a full-time role based on site at our SoHo office.
What you’ll do
Own the office experience

  • Be the main point of contact for the office, and the first stop for questions and requests. Close them out quickly and with care.

  • Welcome visitors and manage guest access, deliveries, mail and packages.

  • Keep the office well maintained, stocked, safe and good-looking, including the kitchen, snacks, printers and meeting rooms.

  • Run the office food and beverage program, from daily lunches and weekly treats to keeping the pantry stocked.

  • Set up desks, badges and equipment for new hires and visiting teammates.

Manage vendors, facilities and the building

  • Build strong relationships with our landlord and on-site building management. That covers key card requests, guest lists for events and booking the freight elevator for deliveries.

  • Manage our cleaning, security, maintenance, HVAC and other facilities vendors.

  • Order supplies and furniture, track inventory and stay within budget.

  • Coordinate repairs, moves and changes to the space.

  • Keep lease, insurance and compliance paperwork current with Finance and Legal.

Bring our culture to life

  • Plan and run in-office events such as team lunches, happy hours and external panels.

  • Support team offsites and onsites, from choosing venues and booking travel to handling logistics on the ground.

  • Partner with People Ops on onboarding and recognition so every new hire has a smooth, memorable first day.

Keep the operations side running

  • Process office invoices and expenses in line with our expense policy.

  • Track the office budget and flag overruns early.

  • Support calendars, travel bookings and ad hoc admin as needed.

  • Partner with People and IT on onboarding, offboarding and equipment.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in office management, facilities, workplace operations or executive administration

  • A proactive, service-minded team player with excellent attention to detail

  • Strong organization and the ability to juggle competing priorities while staying calm

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build good relationships with teammates at every level, as well as with vendors and visitors

  • Comfort negotiating with vendors and keeping to a budget

  • Sound judgment with confidential information and with expense and invoice processing

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack and expense and travel tools

  • Able to work on site in New York five days a week, and to lift and move supplies as needed

Nice to have

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, tech or crypto company

  • Experience planning events of 50+ people, including offsites

  • Familiarity with badge, access-control and building-management systems

  • A basic understanding of office safety and emergency procedures

  • Curiosity about crypto and the Uniswap ecosystem

  • A passion for unicorns

    The pay range for this role is $39.00 - $49.00 per hour, in line with New York City’s Pay Transparency Law. Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills. Full-time employees are also be eligible for tokens and other benefits.

About the role

The Uniswap Labs team is building products to unlock value through universal exchange. Our products, the Uniswap Interface, the Uniswap Mobile App and the Uniswap Extension, are powered by the Uniswap Protocol. When you join Uniswap, you become part of a team reshaping how value flows on the internet.

We are looking for a Head of Talent to build and lead how Uniswap Labs finds, hires and develops great people. You will define the long-term talent strategy, lead the recruiting team, and partner with leadership to hire the engineers, designers and operators who build what comes next.

Responsibilities

  • Own Uniswap Labs' long-term talent strategy and workforce plan, working with the executive team on priorities, headcount, org design and timing

  • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on role scoping, leveling and compensation

  • Set a high, consistent hiring bar and keep it as we grow

  • Work with team leads on internal talent development: career paths, promotions, mobility and succession for key roles

  • Help shape how we assess performance and growth

  • Build, mentor, and scale the recruiting team, from in-house recruiters and coordinators

  • Stay close to the work: take on key searches yourself, including senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Build proactive pipelines through sourcing, talent mapping and relationships across engineering, product, design within and beyond the industry

  • Run a candidate experience that is fast, clear and respectful, from first call through offer and close

  • Own recruiting operations: our ATS and tooling, interview process, interviewer training and scheduling

  • Track pipeline, speed, quality and cost, and use the data to improve how we hire

  • Work with other team leads on leveling, compensation, onboarding and a smooth first day for every new hire

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, including 3+ years leading recruiting teams in a fast-growing technology company

  • A track record of building a recruiting function from a small team and scaling it, while staying hands-on

  • Experience hiring senior engineering, product, design, and business talent in competitive markets

  • Experience with long-term workforce planning, org design and talent strategy, working directly across the leadership team

  • Strong judgment advising leaders on hiring strategy, role design, leveling and compensation

  • Experience supporting internal talent development, such as performance, career paths and succession, alongside recruiting

  • Comfort with data: you set metrics, read the pipeline and change the process when the numbers say so

  • Hands-on experience with an ATS and recruiting tools, and the ability to choose and improve our stack

  • A clear, direct communicator who builds trust with candidates, hiring managers and your own team

  • Able to work from our SoHo, New York office

Nice to have

  • Recruiting experience at a crypto, tech or other high-bar, fast-moving company

  • A network of senior engineering, product, design, and business talent in tech

  • Experience leading or partnering on people work beyond recruiting, such as talent development, performance programs and succession planning

  • Experience across recruiting and people operations, such as leveling, compensation design and onboarding

  • Curiosity about crypto and the Uniswap ecosystem

Minimum full-time salary of $238,400-$298,000. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law. Full Time employees at Uniswap Labs are also eligible for other compensation elements, including tokens, and benefits, dependent on the position type.

Uniswap Labs' Full-Time employee benefits include company-paid medical, dental, & vision for you and your dependents, wellness offerings including a partnership with Equinox Fitness Clubs, 401(k) with 4% employer contribution, annual $1,500 education stipend, unlimited and encouraged time off, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, home office setup stipend for remote employees and daily lunches at NY headquarters (all benefits are subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility).

Uniswap Labs is committed to diversity in our workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability (including gender dysphoria and similar gender-related conditions), sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation (including actual or perceived heterosexuality, homosexuality, bisexuality, and asexuality), veteran status, military status, domestic violence victim status, reproductive health decision making or any other protected category. In addition, Uniswap Labs participates in E-Verify. You can view the E-Verify poster here and the Right to Work poster here.
